Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.ssh

Class SshProfile

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.ssh.SshProfile
public class SshProfile extends Object
A saved SSH connection profile: everything needed to reach one remote host.

Plain Jackson-serializable bean (no-arg constructor + getters/setters) persisted by SshProfileStore as JSON. Carries no live connection; opening one is the job of SshSession.

The password is never persisted by default. When isSavePassword() is true, the store writes an obfuscated (not encrypted) form. Private-key paths are stored but passphrases are not.
